_comment: Canonical industry taxonomy for the social-proof pipeline (QB v5 Phase 4). Ids = the dynapps country-website industry slugs (source of truth: /<lang>/industries/<id> pages + case-page badges, verified live 2026-07-17 on dynapps.es / dynapps.be / dynapps.ch). DISPLAY LABELS do NOT live here: the exact per-language label (as tagged on each country site) lives in each locale pack under instance.industries (and per case in shared/references/<CC>.json industry_label). This file carries only language-neutral structure: brand colour per industry, adjacency (for match_cases v2 adjacent-industry scoring) and multilingual match tokens (accent-folded substrings, used to map a prospect's free-text sector to an industry id).
_nav_note: The 8 ids marked nav:true are the primary website navigation taxonomy (Ine's list). 'laboratories' and 'financial-services' are additionally used by the sites as case badges / industry pages (dynapps.be nav includes laboratories; dynapps.ch nav includes financial-services), so they are canonical too — a reference card must be able to show them.
_color_note: Colours from the Dynapps extended digital palette, per Víctor's decision (pure palette, no derived tints). 10 industries over 6 colours => two deliberate reuses (construction/food-beverage share #FF7E23; manufacturing/pharma-biotech share #951CF3). All chosen fills are readable with white text except #FF7759/#FF7E23 which are borderline — prefer dark text on those two if the render layer supports it.
